title: potentilla villosa var. uniflora
intro: Potentilla villosa var. uniflora, commonly known as Dwarf Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use in treating inflammation, digestive issues, and as an antiseptic agent to aid in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Cinquefoil are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
